name: Withered Bone
description: Misc item, a giant bone knotted like old wood. Internal ID WitheredBone, stack 30, weight 1.0.
usedFor: Crafting: listed as an ingredient in the Nimble Anklet (amount and station not stated on this page)
Boss summon: ten Withered Bones are needed to summon the third boss, Bonemass, at the Forsaken altar
obtainedFrom: Muddy scrap piles in Sunken Crypts

name: Tar
description: Material, a sticky lump of tar. Internal ID Tar, stack 50, weight 2.0.
usedFor: Building (page lists pieces but gives no amounts): Black metal chest, Carved darkwood divider, Darkwood arch, Darkwood beam 2m, Darkwood beam 4m, Darkwood beam 26°, Darkwood beam 45°, Darkwood chair, Darkwood gate, Darkwood pole 2m, Darkwood pole 4m, Hot tub, Long heavy table, Raven adornment, Round table, Wolf adornment
Building, roofs (no amounts): Shingle roof 26°, ridge 26°, o-corner 26°, i-corner 26°, Shingle roof 45°, ridge 45°, o-corner 45°, i-corner 45°
Crafting: Blob bomb (amount not stated on the Tar page)
obtainedFrom: Found in and around Tar pits in the Plains biome

name: Sharpening Stone
description: Material, a whetstone wheel. Internal ID SharpeningStone, stack 20, weight 6.0.
usedFor: Building: Grinding wheel (the only piece the page lists)
obtainedFrom: Rarely found in Plains chests in Fuling Villages, Fuling Outposts and Fuling Ruins

name: Bell
description: Misc item used to summon the Ashlands boss Fader. Internal ID Bell, stack 9, weight 0.5.
usedFor: Boss summon: three Bells summon Fader (9 Bell fragments in total)
obtainedFrom: Crafted at the Black forge from Bell fragments
Bell fragments come from Charred Fortresses (Ashlands)
recipe: Bell fragment x3 at the Black forge

name: Torch
description: Club-type utility weapon and light source. Internal ID Torch.
usedFor: Light source; when equipped it acts like a fire and scares off Necks, untamed Boars, Greylings and Greydwarfs
Weapon: blunt 4 plus fire 15 damage, 3-hit combo
Can be held in main or off hand
obtainedFrom: The player starts the game with one
gameVersionNote: not stated. Contradiction on the page: the infobox says Source is the player crafting menu, while the upgrade table says Workbench level 1. It loses durability while equipped and lasts at most 10 minutes; it cannot be repaired.

name: Hammer
description: Tool used to build fires, workbenches, buildings and furniture. Internal ID Hammer.
usedFor: Building: opens the build menu with right click (you cannot block while holding it)
obtainedFrom: Recipe unlocked from the start of the game; no crafting station needed
recipe: Quality 1: Wood x3, Stone x2 (no station). Upgrades: quality 2 Wood x1 Stone x1 (workbench level 2), quality 3 Wood x2 Stone x2 (workbench level 3)

name: Hoe
description: Tool for levelling or raising ground and laying paths. Internal ID Hoe.
usedFor: Levelling, raising and slightly lowering ground; raising ground costs 2 Stone per operation and needs a workbench nearby
Applying Pathen and Paved Road ground decorations
recipe: Wood x5, Stone x2 at Workbench level 1. Upgrades: quality 2 Wood x1 Stone x1 (workbench level 2), quality 3 Wood x2 Stone x2 (workbench level 3)

name: Cultivator
description: Farming tool for tilling soil, planting seeds and trees, and restoring grass. Internal ID Cultivator.
usedFor: Preparing cultivated soil for food crops
Planting trees (needs cleared space, not cultivated ground)
Grass mode: regrow grass, lily pads, create sand on shoreline, regrow cattails in some shore areas
Uses stamina; the page says Hildir's clothing helps on large farms
obtainedFrom: Crafted at a Forge; becomes available once you have Bronze and Corewood
recipe: Corewood x5, Bronze x5 at the Forge. Upgrades: quality 2 Corewood x1 Bronze x1, quality 3 Corewood x2 Bronze x2

name: Beech Seeds
description: Seed that grows a Beech tree when planted with the Cultivator. Internal ID BeechSeeds, stack 100.
usedFor: Farming: plant with the Cultivator to grow a Beech tree; grow time 3000-5000 s; no cultivated ground needed; needs 4 m of space
Grows in Meadows, Black Forest and Plains; cannot grow in the Swamp

name: Birch Seeds
description: Seed that grows a Birch tree when planted with the Cultivator. Internal ID BirchSeeds, stack 100.
usedFor: Farming: plant with the Cultivator to grow a Birch tree; grow time 5000-7000 s; no cultivated ground needed; needs 4 m of space
Grows in Meadows, Black Forest and Plains
obtainedFrom: Birch trees; the drop rate depends on whether the tree was planted and which biome it came from (details are on another page)
